thread:
aaron: quick follow-up after the recurring late-night pages. want concrete owners/dates for the alert-tuning items so we don't see the same noise next week.

aaron: action items I captured: 1) reduce rule fanout for redis-errors, 2) increase dedupe window and add dedupe key, 3) tighten prod-api thresholds with canary, 4) add quiet-hours suppression and update paging policy, 5) runbook handback + dashboard for suppressed pages.

beth: i'll take #1 (fanout). plan: change fanout grouping from instance_id -> region, drop hosts with <1% error contribution. will test small subset in staging today.

carlos: i'll own #2 and #3. for dedupe window i suggest 60s -> 240s and introduce dedupe_key=region:instance_type. for thresholds i'll canary the new threshold in us-east for 12h and set auto-backout if pages >1 within 30m.

aaron: thanks. #4 quiet-hours suppression -- i can do that and wire it into paging policy: suppress severity=warning between 23:00-06:00 UTC, route critical as usual.

beth: quick config I'll trial in staging for fanout reduction: "group_by: [region] drop_if_contrib_lt: 0.01" will post snippet in PR.

carlos: noted. I'll add a dashboard panel: dedupe_suppressed_pages and suppressed_page_rate to validate changes.

alerts-bot: created ticket ONCALL-878: "alert noise: redis fanout + dedupe + quiet-hours" linked to PM doc https://docs.internal/pm/2026-04-10

aaron: tentative dates: beth staging test by EOD Thu (1767319999), carlos canary Fri 09:00 UTC (1767326400), quiet-hours PR by Fri afternoon, dashboard update next Mon.

beth: ack. will post staging results here and open PR for SRE review.
carlos: ack. will post canary plan and rollback hooks.

aaron: reminder: whoever flips these on, please also update the runbook "Alert tuning checklist" with owner + rollback steps. I'll take the runbook edits after changes are live.

beth: small ask: add a metric for pages_suppressed_by_quiet_hours so we can measure false suppressions.
carlos: agree, will add.

alerts-bot: reminder set: /remind @eng-oncall to review ONCALL-878 on 1767403200

aaron: thanks all. if anything blocks please escalate here and tag @aaron.
